notes: Source: Colts 2026 media guide, 'REGULAR INDIVIDUAL' record pages pp. 579-598 (page headers read 'REGULAR INDIVIDUAL'; pages carry no printed page numbers, pdf_page = PDF page). Regular season only; playoff (pp. 611-617), team (599-610, 618-624) and opponent (625-629) records, and the 100-yard-game lists (630-637), were ignored. Sections are headed by readable blue bars (RUSHING YARDS, PASSING TOUCHDOWNS, ...) with sub-lists headed 'MOST ... (CAREER/SEASON/GAME)'.

FRANCHISE SCOPE: the lists print Baltimore Colts (1953-83) and Indianapolis Colts (1984-) together as one franchise record, e.g. John Unitas 1956-72, Lenny Moore 1956-67, Raymond Berry 1955-67 and Bobby Boyd 1960-68 stand in the same lists as Peyton Manning (1998-11) and Andrew Luck (2012-18). There are no separate Baltimore-only or Indianapolis-only lists; opponents' 'Bal' means the Ravens.

through_season 2025: the lists contain 2025 entries (e.g. 'Jonathan Taylor vs. Atl, Nov. 9, 2025', 'Jonathan Taylor, 2025' in the season rushing lists) and the year-by-year leader tables on pp. 638-646 end with 2025.
Ties: this guide prints the value on every tied row, so tied rows are adjacent with equal values; rank = printed position of the first row of a tie group, all rows of the group get tie:true.

Tie groups at the record value are included in full where that is the whole list (receiving TDs in a game: 22 rows at 3; interceptions in a game: 10 rows at 3). The rushing-TD game list is cut after the three 4-TD rows (17 more rows at 3 TDs follow in the guide).
'(23 times) Last: NAME' (sacks, game) means 23 games tied at 3 sacks and only the latest is named; that row carries tie:true and is not a sole record holder.
Rows printed as 'Name (N), years' (e.g. 'Peyton Manning (3), 2000, 2009-10') are one row for N seasons with the same value; years holds the printed season list, raw keeps the whole printed text.

Dates: the guide prints 'Oct. 31, 2004' / 'December 22, 2024'; the years field of game rows holds M/D/YYYY; raw keeps the printed wording. Active players are printed in bold blue in the guide (no meaning for the data).

Name edit: the career sacks list prints 'Duane Bicket, 1985-93' (typo; the same guide prints Duane Bickett in the game and rookie sacks lists on the same page). name = 'Duane Bickett', raw keeps the printed 'Duane Bicket'.

Scrimmage lists (PLAYS FROM SCRIMMAGE, p594-595) and 'MOST GAMES ...' / 'GAMES WITH ...' counts were not used; rushing and receiving yards come from the RUSHING YARDS and RECEIVING YARDS sections only.

Tackles: not printed anywhere in the records (searched the whole guide text for tackle lists: only player bios and community pages mention tackles), so all three tackles pairs are listed under missing.
